scientific_limitations: Only lengths one through six, complete cyclic DFT intensities and cubic-root-valued full-support words are classified.
No claim of phase-retrieval stability under noise or of a classification at lengths above six.
Equivalent historical tables may exist outside the indexed literature.
title: First cyclic Fourier-magnitude ambiguity for cubic-phase words: a unique triple fiber
